methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: To determine the energy consumption from coal the quantitate consumption at the plant was measured (tonne). This value was converted to energy consumption (kWh) and cost (R) values in order to compare it to electricity consumption and cost.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A case study was used to investigate the effect that the cost of the energy sources has on a cement plant.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The method was applied to a South African cement plant.

stage1.notes: The applied indicator compares coal and electricity through converted energy, cost distributions, and R/kWh ratios.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: The use of an ISO 50001 based system would provide a plant with a conceptual framework that allows them to develop a holistic approach to energy management.

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: Upon comparing the consumption and cost for the two energy sources, the ratio of consumption to cost was calculated. This provides a R/kWh value, which makes it possible to compare the price of the two energy sources.

normalisation_variables.evidence_quote: In order to determine the energy consumed by using coal it was necessary to obtain the monthly average calorific value for the specific period. Calorific value is measured in GJ/t, making it possible to calculate the GJ value of the energy obtained from the coal. This value can then be converted to kWh. The calorific value of coal cannot be measured continuously, due to the lengthy lab procedures used to conduct such tests. The calorific values of coal shipments to the plant are, however, measured. Thus, average monthly calorific values of coal shipments were used for this investigation. By making use of the South African coal export price for each month of the relevant financial year1, as well as the tonnes coal consumed, the cost of the coal consumption for each month of the financial year can be estimated.

baseline_construction_method.value: No energy baseline was constructed. Monthly coal quantity was converted to energy using average monthly calorific values, and monthly coal export prices were used with coal consumed to estimate monthly cost.
